meaning:
κατα-πέτασμα, -τος, τό
(= cl. παραπέτασμα) [in LXX chiefly for פֹּרֶכֶת (the veil of the Holy of Holies), Exo.26:31, Lev.21:23, al.; also for מָסָךְ (the outer veil), Exo.35:12, Num_3:26, al. (elsewhere κάλυμμα) ;]
in NT always the inner veil or curtain of the Temple (or Tabernacle): Mat.27:51, Mrk.15:38, Luk.23:45, Heb.6:19 9:3; figuratively, ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ Heb.10:20.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.
The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.
This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil;
